findings.answerCheck: Order: I had seen the stored solution when first reading answers.md, but I counted the grid boxes on p-06 independently and only then tested the stored words against the counts. 2 down FACEBOOK (8 letters, C 3rd) fits. 3 down RECREATION (10 letters, N 10th) does NOT fit a 7-box entry whose 6th letter is N. 4 down MEDITATION (10 letters, D 3rd) does NOT fit a 7-box entry whose 4th letter is D. So the stored solution's entries (3) and (4) must change. The print fixes only the pattern: (3) = _ _ _ _ _ N _ (7), e.g. READING / SINGING / DANCING / WALKING / SMILING; (4) = _ _ _ D _ _ _ (7), e.g. MINDFUL / MINDSET. I cannot settle a unique word from the print alone; the board's model answer or the textbook's Social Health chapter should decide before the solution is rewritten.
